rules.statement: Appeals concerning the taking of an account, as in a judicial settlement of accounts under section 729 of the Civil Procedure Code, will not be entertained by the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council if questions of fact rather than principles of law are involved.
rules.supporting_quote: "Appeals concerned with the taking of an account, as in a judicial settlement of accounts under section 729 of the Civil Procedure Code, will not be entertained by the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council if questions of fact rather than principles of law are involved."
